Bitcoin Spot ETFs See $176M Total Net Inflows on October 27 According to SoSoValue data, US Bitcoin spot ETFs recorded a total net inflow of $176 million on October 27 Eastern Time, with BlackRock's IBIT leading at $151 million in net inflows. Ethereum spot ETFs saw a total net outflow of $60.22 million, with BlackRock's ETHA being the sole fund recording net outflows. — link

Highlight Clip: Jack Dorsey: Bitcoin Fails If It Ends Up Just Being Digital Gold (ARCHIVE FOOTAGE) Jack Dorsey: Bitcoin Fails If It Ends Up Just Being Digital Gold (ARCHIVE FOOTAGE) In a January 16, 2025 interview published by Abundant Mines, Block co-founder Jack Dorsey said nation-state Bitcoin reserves are good for the state but not necessarily for Bitcoin. He said Bitcoin would be a failure if it ends up just being digital gold, pointing to the white paper, which described peer-to-peer electronic cash. It would only succeed, he said, if people could use it as money in daily life and move funds without asking permission. — link

Brazil’s Largest Private Bank Itaú Unibanco Becomes Country’s First to Notify Regulator of Crypto Brokerage Operations Under New Rules Brazil’s largest private bank, Itaú Unibanco, notified the central bank of its cryptocurrency trading and custody operations on October 27, becoming the country’s first bank to do so under the new digital-asset rules. The framework allows banks already authorized by the central bank to offer crypto services through a notification process, while dedicated virtual-asset service providers must apply for operating authorization. The deadline for existing operators to submit notifications or applications is October 30. Itaú has offered crypto services since December 2023 and currently supports 15 cryptoassets. — link

Google Unveils MPC Service to Secure Crypto and Tokenized Assets Google is developing an MPC service to help financial institutions secure and transfer crypto and tokenized assets. Now in private preview, it is expected to launch commercially in early 2027. Google’s parent company, Alphabet, already uses the technology to secure digital assets on Ethereum and Solana, though it has not disclosed which assets. — link
